title: Share platform discovery of vault signing programs
goal: Vision: V-6. Use one GnuPG companion lookup for the core-only and commercial-paired vault entry points served by core. Retain PATH and installation-directory search order on Windows, macOS and Linux.

reuse.searched: The vaulted GPG command resolver, existing platform-specific candidate lists, and commercial vault counterpart. The standalone core directly provides the wrapper and cannot depend on a commercial install.
